- [ ] **Focus States**: `focus-visible` or `focus:ring` on all interactive elements
- [ ] **Transitions**: Add `transition-*` classes for smooth state changes
- **Skip Links**: Add `sr-only` skip links for keyboard users

content.value_statement: Tailwind projects can become inconsistent across components and breakpoints. This skill guides responsive utility classes, theme setup, dark mode, and accessibility checks.
actual_capabilities: Guides mobile-first breakpoint usage with sm, md, lg, xl, and 2xl patterns.
Provides Tailwind theme extension guidance for colors, spacing, fonts, and dark mode.
Shows component patterns for buttons, KPI cards, forms, dashboard grids, and toggles.
Recommends accessibility checks for contrast, focus states, touch targets, skip links, and ARIA labels.
Covers performance practices such as JIT mode, purging unused classes, minification, critical CSS, and code splitting.
limitations: Applies only to Tailwind CSS projects, not plain CSS or CSS-in-JS.
Provides guidance and examples, not automated visual testing.
Does not fetch Tailwind documentation or install packages by itself.
Does not guarantee contrast compliance without project-specific color validation.

use_cases.title: Style a responsive component
use_cases.description: Turn a basic React component into a mobile-first Tailwind component with clear breakpoints and state styles.

use_cases.title: Extend a design theme
use_cases.description: Plan Tailwind theme tokens for colors, spacing, fonts, and dark mode without replacing the default theme.

use_cases.title: Review interface quality
use_cases.description: Check Tailwind classes for accessibility, focus states, touch targets, dark mode, and production readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Style a simple component
prompt_templates.prompt: Style this component with Tailwind CSS. Start with mobile styles, add clear spacing, and include focus and hover states.

prompt_templates.title: Make a layout responsive
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this layout to a mobile-first Tailwind layout. Use sm, md, lg, and xl breakpoints only where the design needs them.

prompt_templates.title: Create theme and variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Design Tailwind theme extensions for this interface. Include semantic colors, dark mode behavior, spacing choices, and reusable component variants.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a dashboard interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Tailwind dashboard for responsive behavior, accessibility, dark mode, class consistency, and production performance risks.

output_examples.input: Make this KPI card responsive and dark-mode ready.
output_examples.output: The card should use full width on mobile, add larger padding at tablet sizes, and use paired light and dark surface colors.

output_examples.input: Review my Tailwind form classes for accessibility.
output_examples.output: The review calls out missing focus styles, touch targets under 44 pixels, and color pairs that need contrast validation.

output_examples.input: Plan a Tailwind theme for a product dashboard.
output_examples.output: The result defines semantic color groups, spacing rules, font choices, dark mode strategy, and guidance for reusable variants.

best_practices: Start with unprefixed mobile utilities, then add larger breakpoint variants.
Use semantic theme names and extend the default Tailwind theme.
Verify focus states, touch targets, and contrast in light and dark modes.
anti_patterns: Styling desktop first and patching mobile with overrides.
Replacing simple utility classes with large custom CSS blocks.
Adding dark mode colors without checking contrast.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when a project uses Tailwind CSS for component styling, responsive layouts, themes, or dark mode.

faq.question: Does this skill apply to plain CSS?
faq.answer: No. It is written for Tailwind CSS and utility-first class workflows.

faq.question: Can it help with responsive design?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes mobile-first styling and breakpoint choices for common interface layouts.

faq.question: Does it include accessibility guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers contrast, focus states, touch target size, skip links, and ARIA labels.

faq.question: Can it update Tailwind configuration?
faq.answer: It can guide theme extension choices for colors, spacing, fonts, and dark mode settings.

faq.question: Does it run external tools?
faq.answer: No evidence found. The reviewed file contains guidance and examples, not executable commands.
